verdict.rationale: Resend documents an SMTP integration with host smtp.resend.com, several ports (25, 465, 587, 2465, 2587), username 'resend', and the password set to an API key. That key is a credential you generate through the documented create-API-key flow, which supports a send-only 'sending_access' scope. This gives legacy apps and frameworks a documented relay path that does not need the REST API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SMTP relay use, and any SMTP-specific credentials separate from API keys.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send through a documented SMTP relay with generated credentials when my framework or legacy app can't call the REST API

citations.quote: Learn how to integrate Resend via SMTP.
Add a new API key to authenticate communications with Resend.
